research_question: How have chlorinated volatile organic compound (CVOC) concentrations evolved in groundwater over time at a contaminated landfill site, and what do these trends indicate about the effectiveness of natural attenuation?

phase_1.user_prompt: I am evaluating the natural attenuation of chlorinated volatile organic compounds (CVOCs) in groundwater at a former landfill site in Washington state. I will be focusing on two specific USGS groundwater monitoring wells: 474152122373101 (piezometer P1-4) and 474153122373301 (well MW1-28). Identify the 5-digit USGS parameter codes for discrete water quality samples of the following primary contaminants and degradation products: Tetrachloroethene (PCE), Trichloroethene (TCE), cis-1,2-Dichloroethene (cis-DCE), trans-1,2-Dichloroethene (trans-DCE), and Vinyl Chloride (VC).

phase_2.user_prompt: Download the discrete groundwater quality sample data for PCE, TCE, cis-DCE, trans-DCE, and Vinyl Chloride at the two identified monitoring wells (474152122373101 and 474153122373301) for the period from January 1, 1996 through December 31, 2013.

phase_3.user_prompt: Process the retrieved water quality data to extract the maximum recorded concentration of cis-1,2-Dichloroethene (cis-DCE) across the entire available record up to 2013 for the piezometer site 474152122373101. Report the result in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

phase_4.user_prompt: Calculate the 'Total CVOC' concentration for site 474152122373101 during its July 2013 sampling event. Total CVOC is defined as the sum of all positively detected concentrations of PCE, TCE, cis-DCE, trans-DCE, and Vinyl Chloride (treat non-detects, often marked with a '<' qualifier, as 0). Create a line plot showing this Total CVOC sum over time from 1999 to 2013, saving it as `p1_4_cvoc_trend.png`. Briefly summarize if the time-series indicates active natural attenuation.

checkpoint.reference_conclusion: Total CVOC concentrations at the site decreased substantially from over 5,500 µg/L in 1999 to 790 µg/L in 2013, indicating significant ongoing natural attenuation and reductive dechlorination. The visualization should be a line plot showing a clear overall downward trajectory in summed CVOCs over the observation period.
checkpoint.visual_description: A line plot tracking time (x-axis, 1999 to 2013) against Total CVOC concentration in µg/L (y-axis) for site 474152122373101. The curve should start high (around 5,500) and show an overall downward trend, ending near 790 µg/L in 2013.
